heading.zh-Hant: 拉瓦納戈拉與王室派抵抗運動
heading.en: Ravna Gora and the royalist resistance

body.zh-Hant: 1941年4月南斯拉夫軍隊迅速而潰敗地戰敗後，米哈伊洛維奇與部下於1941年5月11日聚集在塞爾維亞西部的拉瓦納戈拉高原。他們最初以「南斯拉夫軍契特尼克支隊」為名；新軍事組織「祖國南斯拉夫軍」則在1942年6月完成改組。1941年秋天的事件使王室派與共產黨游擊隊陷入互相敵對，其間的內戰決定了此後塞爾維亞與南斯拉夫的戰局。
body.en: After the quick and inglorious defeat of the Yugoslav Army in April 1941, Mihailović and his men gathered on the plateau of Ravna Gora in western Serbia on 11 May 1941. They first called themselves the Chetnik Detachments of the Yugoslav Army; the new military organization, the Yugoslav Army in the Homeland, was finished in June 1942. The events of autumn 1941 set the royalists and the Partisans against each other, and the civil war between them decided the further course of the war in Serbia and Yugoslavia.

heading.zh-Hant: 流亡政府部長與最高統帥部參謀長
heading.en: Minister in the government-in-exile and chief of staff of the Supreme Command

body.zh-Hant: 1942年1月11日，米哈伊洛維奇獲任命為以斯洛博丹·約瓦諾維奇為首的新南斯拉夫政府的陸海空軍部長。同年6月10日，國王彼得請約瓦諾維奇將南斯拉夫軍的最高統帥部移往被佔領的祖國，並請以米哈伊洛維奇為其參謀長；他於6月17日晉升為陸軍上將。
body.en: On 11 January 1942 Mihailović was appointed Minister of the Army, Navy and Air Force in the new Yugoslav government headed by Slobodan Jovanović. On 10 June King Peter asked Jovanović to transfer the supreme command of the Yugoslav army to the occupied homeland and to place Mihailović as its chief of staff; Mihailović was promoted to the rank of army general on 17 June.

heading.zh-Hant: 撤職、澤倫戈拉戰役與審判
heading.en: Dismissal, the Zelengora battle and trial

body.zh-Hant: 1944年6月1日國王解散流亡政府，使米哈伊洛維奇自動失去陸海空軍部長職務；8月29日國王簽署廢止南斯拉夫軍高級統帥部的法令，他也不再能擔任其參謀長。1945年5月13日，王室派與游擊隊在澤倫戈拉山區進行決定性戰役。他隱匿後於1946年3月13日被捕，6月10日以叛國、通敵及戰爭罪遭起訴，7月17日被槍決。
body.en: On 1 June 1944 the King dismissed the government-in-exile, which automatically removed Mihailović as minister, and on 29 August he signed an act abolishing the High Command of the Yugoslav Army, so Mihailović could no longer be its chief of staff. The decisive battle between the Partisans and the royalists was fought on 13 May 1945 on Zelengora. Mihailović went into hiding, was captured on 13 March 1946, indicted on 10 June for treason, collaboration with the Germans and war crimes, and executed by firing squad on 17 July.

heading.zh-Hant: 出身、軍團與戰間期
heading.en: Origins, the Legion and the interwar army

body.zh-Hant: 盧德維克·斯沃博達1895年11月25日生於捷克摩拉維亞高地的赫羅茲納廷。1915年9月他在東線被俄軍俘虜，1916年8月加入捷克斯洛伐克軍團，曾在茲博羅夫等地作戰；1921年成為職業軍官，1931至1934年在赫拉尼采軍事學院教授匈牙利語。1939年6月初他前往波蘭，加入捷克斯洛伐克境外軍隊。
body.en: Ludvík Svoboda was born on 25 November 1895 in Hroznatín in the Bohemian-Moravian Highlands. He was taken prisoner on the Eastern Front in September 1915, joined the Czechoslovak Legions in August 1916 and fought at Zborov among other places. He became a professional officer in 1921 and from 1931 to 1934 taught Hungarian at the Military Academy in Hranice. In early June 1939 he went to Poland and joined the Czechoslovak army abroad.

heading.zh-Hant: 波蘭、布祖盧克與旅長時期
heading.en: Poland, Buzuluk and the brigade

body.zh-Hant: 1939年6月5日，斯沃博達被迫離開祖國前往波蘭；捷克國防部資料稱他在當地組織了一支捷克斯洛伐克部隊，並於同年9月把它轉移到蘇聯。布祖盧克的第1捷克斯洛伐克獨立野戰營成立後，他於1942年7月15日被任命為營長；索科洛沃戰鬥之後，1943年5月他成為第1捷克斯洛伐克獨立旅旅長，1944年1月晉升准將。
body.en: On 5 June 1939 Svoboda was forced to leave for Poland; the Czech Ministry of Defence says he organised a Czechoslovak military unit there and moved it to the Soviet Union in September 1939. After the 1st Czechoslovak Independent Field Battalion was founded at Buzuluk he was appointed its commander on 15 July 1942; after the fighting at Sokolovo he became commander of the 1st Czechoslovak Independent Brigade in May 1943 and was promoted brigadier general in January 1944.

heading.zh-Hant: 蘇聯境內的捷克斯洛伐克部隊與索科洛沃、基輔
heading.en: The Czechoslovak unit in the USSR: Sokolovo and Kiev

body.zh-Hant: 1941年6月德國入侵蘇聯後，斯沃博達成為第1捷克斯洛伐克野戰營營長；該營自1942年2月在布祖盧克編成，1943年5月成為第1捷克斯洛伐克獨立旅。該部隊1943年3月投入前線，4月2日在哈爾科夫附近的索科洛沃打了首場主要戰役，並在蘇軍向第聶伯河推進、解放基輔的戰鬥中作戰。
body.en: After the German invasion of the USSR in June 1941 Svoboda became commander of the 1st Czechoslovak Field Battalion, which had been forming at Buzuluk since February 1942; in May 1943 it became the 1st Czechoslovak Independent Brigade. The unit was committed to the front in March 1943 and fought its first major action on 2 April at Sokolovo near Kharkov; it also took part in the battles that ended with the liberation of Kiev.

heading.zh-Hant: 接掌第1軍與杜克拉山口戰役
heading.en: Taking over the 1st Corps and the Battle of the Dukla Pass

body.zh-Hant: 1944年9月，這支部隊擴編為蘇聯境內的第1捷克斯洛伐克軍。蘇聯方面希望由斯沃博達取代原軍長克拉托赫維爾，柯涅夫為此奔走，獲得倫敦同意。1944年10月6日該軍突破杜克拉山口南端進入斯洛伐克，代價慘重：第1旅旅長韋德拉爾越界不久即觸雷身亡，估計約6,500人陣亡，近半原有兵力。
body.en: In September 1944 the unit became the 1st Czechoslovak Army Corps in the USSR. The Soviets wanted Kratochvíl removed in favour of Svoboda, Konev pressed the matter and London agreed. On 6 October 1944 the corps cleared the south end of the Dukla Pass and entered Slovakia at a heavy cost: the 1st Brigade commander, General Vedral, was killed by a mine soon after crossing the border, and an estimated 6,500 men, almost half the corps, had been killed.

body.en: Svoboda was appointed Minister of National Defence on 4 April 1945; the Czech government website gives his term as lasting until 24 April 1950. He was subsequently also supreme commander of the Czechoslovak armed forces and was promoted army general on 1 August 1945. He was removed as minister in April 1950, replaced by Alexej Čepička, and was rehabilitated in 1954.

body.zh-Hant: 1950年4月斯沃博達被免去國防部長職務，並一度被任命為副總理（náměstek předsedy vlády）；1951年9月被解除全部職務，1952年11月曾被拘捕一個月。1968年3月他在布拉格之春期間當選捷克斯洛伐克總統，後因病重，1975年5月依特別法被免除職務；他1979年9月20日卒於布拉格，葬於克羅梅日什。
body.en: In April 1950 Svoboda was removed as Minister of National Defence and for a time appointed deputy prime minister; in September 1951 he was stripped of all functions and in November 1952 was arrested for a month. He was elected president of Czechoslovakia in March 1968 during the Prague Spring, later fell seriously ill and was removed from office by a special law in May 1975. He died in Prague on 20 September 1979 and is buried in Kroměříž.

heading.zh-Hant: 出身與參謀生涯
heading.en: Origins and staff career

body.zh-Hant: 簡·哥利昂1906年1月26日生於匈牙利多姆博瓦爾，1927年自摩拉維亞赫拉尼采軍事學院畢業，任砲兵少尉。1938年10月2日他以上尉軍階任第10師師部第2處處長。1943年12月19日獲任命為班斯卡·比斯特里察地面部隊司令部參謀長，自1944年1月1日起生效。
body.en: Ján Golian was born on 26 January 1906 in Dombóvár, Hungary, and graduated from the military academy in Hranice in Moravia in 1927 as an artillery second lieutenant. From 2 October 1938 he served as a captain, head of the second section of the staff of the 10th Division. On 19 December 1943 he was named chief of staff of the Ground Forces Command in Banská Bystrica, effective 1 January 1944.

body.zh-Hant: 1938年10月2日起，哥利昂以上尉軍階任第10師師部第2處處長。1941年6月27日他隨司令部開赴前線，至11月13日返回，其後任第1師區司令部參謀長，至1942年5月31日。1942年7月29日他再赴前線，任快速師司令部第4處處長，10月2日返回；1943年3月4日至7月25日又在前線任快速師參謀長。
body.en: From 2 October 1938 Golian, a captain, headed the 2nd department of the 10th Division staff. On 27 June 1941 he went to the front with his headquarters and stayed until 13 November 1941; he then served as chief of staff of the 1st Divisional Area Command until 31 May 1942. On 29 July 1942 he went to the front again as head of the 4th department of the Rapid Division headquarters, returning on 2 October 1942, and from 4 March to 25 July 1943 served at the front as chief of staff of the Rapid Division.

heading.zh-Hant: 起義準備與軍事中心
heading.en: Preparing the uprising and the Military Centre

body.zh-Hant: 1944年4月23日，總統貝奈斯任命他為武裝反法西斯行動籌備的臨時負責人；4月27日他接受地下斯洛伐克民族委員會的委託，擔任起義準備的軍事指揮官。5月14日，倫敦流亡政府的國防部長英格正式任命他為軍事中心司令。6月28日他把軍事計畫送往倫敦，計畫構想由東斯洛伐克的兩個師為紅軍打開喀爾巴阡山隘口。
body.en: On 23 April 1944 President Beneš named him provisional head of preparations for an armed anti-fascist action, and on 27 April he accepted the mandate of the underground Slovak National Council to act as military commander of the uprising preparations. On 14 May Minister of National Defence Ingr of the London government officially appointed him commander of the Military Centre. On 28 June he sent the military plan to London; it envisaged that the Field Army, two eastern Slovak divisions, would open the Carpathian passes for the Red Army.

heading.zh-Hant: 斯洛伐克民族起義與第1捷克斯洛伐克軍
heading.en: The Slovak National Uprising and the 1st Czechoslovak Army

body.zh-Hant: 1944年8月29日晚，國防部長恰特洛什在廣播中承認德軍進駐後，哥利昂下令自20時起進行武裝抵抗，斯洛伐克民族起義爆發。9月4日斯洛伐克民族委員會任命他為捷克斯洛伐克軍隊在斯洛伐克的司令，翌日晉升准將。他指揮第1捷克斯洛伐克軍至10月7日，之後成為新任司令維耶斯特的副手。班斯卡·比斯特里察在8月30日被起義軍奪取，成為政治與軍事指揮中心；起義的戰役主要在該國東部與山區進行。據《貝利亞納百科》，他指揮作戰，部分地點親赴前線；東斯洛伐克兩個師與普雷紹夫軍部很快被德軍解除武裝。
body.en: On the evening of 29 August 1944, after Defence Minister Čatloš confirmed the arrival of German troops in a radio speech, Golian ordered armed resistance from 20:00 and the Slovak National Uprising began. On 4 September the Slovak National Council named him commander of the Czechoslovak army in Slovakia and the next day promoted him to brigadier general. He commanded the 1st Czechoslovak Army until 7 October and then became deputy to its new commander Rudolf Viest. Banská Bystrica, seized on 30 August, became the political and military headquarters, and the insurgents fought mainly in the east and in mountainous areas. Per Beliana he directed operations, in places in person; the East Slovak divisions and the Prešov headquarters were soon disarmed.

heading.zh-Hant: 撤退、被俘與身後
heading.en: Retreat, capture and posthumous honours

body.zh-Hant: 10月27日他隨第1軍司令部自班斯卡·比斯特里察退往多瓦洛維；11月3日在波赫龍斯基布科韋茨，他與維耶斯特等軍官被特別行動隊第14分隊俘虜。他於1945年春在德國死亡，詳情至今未完全查明。1946年他被追晉為師級將軍，1969年追晉為上將。
body.en: On 27 October he withdrew with the staff of the 1st Army from Banská Bystrica to Donovaly; on 3 November he and Viest and other officers were captured by Einsatzkommando 14 at Pohronský Bukovec. He died in Germany in spring 1945 in circumstances that remain unexplained. He was promoted posthumously to division general in 1946 and to colonel general in 1969.

heading.zh-Hant: 出身與軍團、捷克斯洛伐克軍時期
heading.en: Origins, the Legion and the Czechoslovak army

body.zh-Hant: 費迪南德·恰特洛什1895年10月17日生於利普托夫斯基斯維特-彼得，出身石匠家庭。一戰時他被徵入奧匈軍隊，1915年在東線被俄軍俘虜，1917年加入捷克斯洛伐克軍團，官至上尉。1921年重回現役，1927至1930年就讀布拉格高等軍事學校，1938年10月起擔任斯洛伐克自治政府軍事內閣辦公室主任。
body.en: Ferdinand Čatloš was born on 17 October 1895 in Liptovský Svätý Peter into a family of masons. In the First World War he was drafted into the Austro-Hungarian army, was taken prisoner by the Russians on the Eastern Front in 1915 and joined the Czechoslovak Legions in 1917, rising to captain. He returned to active service in 1921, attended the Higher Military School in Prague in 1927–1930 and from October 1938 headed the military cabinet office of the autonomous Slovak government.

heading.zh-Hant: 國防部長與對匈牙利、波蘭、蘇聯的戰役
heading.en: Defence minister and the Hungarian, Polish and Soviet campaigns

body.zh-Hant: 1939年3月14日斯洛伐克國成立，恰特洛什出任蒂索政府的國防部長兼最高軍事指揮官，5月17日晉升一級上將。他在1939年3月的斯洛伐克—匈牙利衝突、同年9月的波蘭戰役以及對蘇聯作戰中擔任指揮。
body.en: When the Slovak State was founded on 14 March 1939, Čatloš became minister of national defence and chief military commander in Tiso's government and was promoted general of the first class from 17 May 1939. He held command in the Slovak–Hungarian conflict of March 1939, in the campaign against Poland in September 1939 and in the campaign against the USSR.

heading.zh-Hant: 波蘭戰役與斯洛伐克野戰軍
heading.en: The Polish campaign and the Slovak field army

body.zh-Hant: 1939年9月，斯洛伐克軍組成「貝爾諾拉克」野戰軍，由國防部長恰特洛什統率，下轄揚諾希克、什庫爾泰蒂、拉祖斯三個師和「卡林恰克」機動群。9月1日凌晨5時斯洛伐克軍越過邊界；9月13日恰特洛什對士兵演說，稱年輕的斯洛伐克軍是德國友人的值得信賴的戰友。
body.en: In September 1939 the Slovak army formed the field army 'Bernolák', commanded by Defence Minister Čatloš, with the divisions Jánošík, Škultéty and Rázus and the manoeuvre group Kalinčak. The Slovak army crossed the border at 5 a.m. on 1 September; on 13 September Čatloš told his soldiers that the young Slovak army had proved worthy brothers in arms of their German friends.

heading.zh-Hant: 1941年1月辭呈未被接受
heading.en: The unaccepted resignation of January 1941

body.zh-Hant: 1941年1月，在圖卡領導的激進派與蒂索領導的保守派的權力鬥爭中，恰特洛什向總統蒂索遞出辭呈，但蒂索最終沒有接受，他留任部長。他向來不諱言與圖卡的良好關係：1939年波蘭戰役後不久，他曾下令為當時的副總理縫製一套將軍制服。
body.en: In January 1941, amid the power struggle between the radical wing led by Tuka and the conservative wing led by President Tiso, Čatloš handed his resignation to Tiso, who in the end did not accept it, and he stayed on as minister. He had made no secret of his good relations with Tuka: shortly after the Polish campaign in 1939 he had ordered a general's uniform made for the then deputy prime minister.

heading.zh-Hant: 疏離德國與「恰特洛什備忘錄」
heading.en: Distancing from Germany and the Čatloš Memorandum

body.zh-Hant: 自1942年底起，恰特洛什開始清洗斯洛伐克軍隊高層中的親德軍官。1944年初他與奧古斯丁·馬拉爾將軍擬定軍事政變計畫，即「恰特洛什備忘錄」，計畫由馬拉爾的東斯洛伐克軍向蘇軍開放喀爾巴阡山隘口；1944年8月4日他以飛機將備忘錄送往蘇聯。
body.en: From the end of 1942 Čatloš began purging the top ranks of the Slovak army of pro-German officers. At the start of 1944 he drew up with General Augustín Malár a plan for a military coup, known as the Čatloš Memorandum, under which Malár's East Slovak army would open the Carpathian passes to Soviet troops; on 4 August 1944 he sent the memorandum to the USSR by aircraft.

heading.zh-Hant: 起義爆發後的拘押、蘇聯與審判
heading.en: Detention, the USSR and trial after the uprising

body.zh-Hant: 1944年8月29日恰特洛什在廣播中宣布德軍進駐，並呼籲軍隊不要抵抗，同日被置於「榮譽拘押」。9月2日他逃往班斯卡·比斯特里察向起義軍效力，遭拒，9月13日被送往蘇聯。1947年12月中旬布拉提斯拉發國民法院判處他五年徒刑，1948年1月獲釋；他於1972年10月16日卒於馬丁。
body.en: On 29 August 1944 Čatloš announced in a radio speech the arrival of German troops and called on the army not to resist, and was placed in "honorary custody". On 2 September he escaped to Banská Bystrica and offered his services to the insurgents, who refused them; on 13 September he was taken to the USSR. In mid-December 1947 the National Court in Bratislava sentenced him to five years in prison, and he was released in January 1948. He died in Martin on 16 October 1972.

heading.zh-Hant: 1944年9月離任與逃往起義區
heading.en: Leaving office and the flight to the insurgent area, September 1944

body.zh-Hant: 據軍事史檔案館清冊，恰特洛什擔任國防部長至1944年9月1日，9月5日由哈希克接任。VHÚ 2024年的研究指出，他於9月1至2日逃往起義區，是因德方正準備逮捕他，他「在最後一刻」做出此決定；倫敦的捷克斯洛伐克政府則拒絕與他合作。
body.en: According to a military archive inventory Čatloš remained minister until 1 September 1944 and Štefan Haššík was appointed on 5 September. A 2024 VHÚ study says he fled to the insurgent territory on 1–2 September because the Germans were preparing to arrest him, deciding 'at the eleventh hour', while the Czechoslovak government in London rejected cooperation with him.

body.zh-Hant: 羅曼·舒赫維奇1907年7月17日生於加利西亞雅沃里夫縣的克拉科韋茨。他1923年加入烏克蘭軍事組織，1929年加入烏克蘭民族主義者組織（OUN），並在其戰鬥部門活動；1930至1934年主持OUN在加利西亞與波蘭的戰鬥部門。他因皮拉茨基遇刺案被捕，在貝雷扎·卡圖斯卡集中營關押六個月；1938至1939年擔任喀爾巴阡謝奇的參謀軍官。
body.en: Roman Shukhevych was born on 17 July 1907 in Krakovets, Yavoriv county, Galicia. He joined the Ukrainian Military Organization in 1923 and the Organization of Ukrainian Nationalists (OUN) in 1929, was active in their combat branches and in 1930–4 headed the OUN combat branch in Galicia and Poland. Arrested in connection with the Pieracki assassination, he was held for six months in the Bereza Kartuzka camp, and in 1938–9 he was a staff officer in the Carpathian Sich.

body.en: He joined the Nachtigall Battalion in April 1941 as its top OUN liaison and political officer. When Nachtigall and Roland were merged in October 1941 into Schutzmannschaftbataillon 201 he was appointed deputy battalion commander and commander of its first company with the rank of captain. The battalion was disarmed and its officers arrested in January 1943; Shukhevych escaped and joined the Ukrainian Insurgent Army (UPA).

body.zh-Hant: 1943年11月，舒赫維奇被任命為UPA總司令，軍階中校；統一指揮體系下，赫里察少校出任參謀長，原伏爾尼亞的UPA定名為UPA北部，中部為UPA南部，加利西亞為UPA西部。1944年7月15日，烏克蘭最高解放委員會（UHVR）選他主持其總書記處並掌軍事部門，1946年他晉升准將。
body.en: In November 1943 Shukhevych was appointed supreme commander of the UPA with the rank of lieutenant colonel; under the unified command Major Dmytro Hrytsai became chief of staff, and the UPA formations were named UPA-North in Volhynia, UPA-South in central Ukraine and UPA-West in Galicia. On 15 July 1944 the Ukrainian Supreme Liberation Council (UHVR) elected him to head its General Secretariat and hold the military portfolio, and in 1946 he was promoted to brigadier general.

heading.zh-Hant: 與蘇德軍隊的戰役及戰死
heading.en: Battles against German and Soviet forces and death

body.zh-Hant: 1944年上半年，UPA北部與南部各隊與蘇聯內務人民委員部部隊之間發生多次伏擊、小規模衝突與大規模戰役；同年夏天，德軍為確保喀爾巴阡山區而與UPA西部爆發數場正面戰鬥。1949年9月3日，舒赫維奇下令解散指揮架構與剩餘作戰部隊，改入地下網絡。他1950年3月5日在利沃夫附近的比洛霍爾夏死於與蘇聯內務部特種部隊的交戰。
body.en: In the first half of 1944 numerous ambushes, skirmishes and large-scale battles occurred between NKVD forces and UPA-North and UPA-South units, and in the summer of 1944 German attempts to secure areas of the Carpathians led to several pitched battles with UPA-West. On 3 September 1949 Shukhevych ordered the command structure and the remaining combat units deactivated and transferred to the underground network. He died on 5 March 1950 at Bilohorshcha near Lviv in combat with special units of the MVD.
